content:
Authentication and Roles context:
- Authentication endpoints are in AIChatApp.API/Controllers/AuthController.cs.
- Shared role names are in AIChatApp.Core/Config/AppRoleNames.cs.
- Role/config seed behavior is connected to BackofficeOptions in AIChatApp.Core/Config/BackofficeOptions.cs and API startup configuration.
- Intended roles: Admin has all access, User has chat app access only, Validator has Backoffice validation access except user management and Machine Learning.
- 2FA/Google Authenticator status and setup are exposed through auth endpoints and shown in Web modals.
- Do not expose real credentials in answers. Refer users to configured seeded development accounts only when safe and requested.
